lines.en: Andrew, I chose you for a reason.
Show me the best numbers this place has ever seen.
Neither am I. It's already done.
Seems like a basic reward system where you give us points and then we redeem those points for prizes.
You're exactly right, and you get a point.
How does one get a point?
I've outlined the exact parameters in an email, so check your spam folders, but basically, you do your job better, you get points.
So, collect 15 points and redeem them for this polar bear.
Why is it all kid stuff in a vibrator? It's so gross.
Or, you can pool your points and redeem 55 for this maternity shirt.
How about you want us to work harder, pay us more?
This point system is really insulting.
Well, I didn't mean to offend you, and I hope you'll forgive me, because I am very, very sorry.
What if we went all the way up to 500 points?
That's a crazy amount of points.
For such a crazy number, I'd like something pretty crazy.
For 500 points, I will wear a dress to work.
I'll run naked through the parking lot with a donut on my ding dong.
For 5,000 points, I will let you tattoo whatever you want on the stern of the old SS Bernard.
Swear to God, hope to die.
But you did say we could pool our points, right?
In that case, let's get to work, guys.
I can have a tea by the beginning next week.
I just want you to benefit from our reward.
Have you noticed a little bit of a mood shift around here?
Because I sat next to Stanley for years, and this is nap time.
He balances the phone on his shoulder and just powers it down.
You've got to unleash the power of the pyramid.
I don't know what to tell you, man.
I can send you an email confirmation.
You think it has something to do with that incentive program?
We all want to see you tattoo your ass.
I think people thought I was kidding when I said that.
And that came across loud and clear.
Oh, by the way, I want to hand this in.
I don't really care about the points.
I would like a point receipt, though.
Yes, this is Jim Halper calling for Donald.

I'm not as big as your drunk I am.
